name: Having An Affair
overview: Scripture clearly condemns having an affair, emphasizing that adultery is not only a physical act but also a matter of the heart, as Jesus teaches that lustful intent is equivalent to committing adultery in one's heart (Matthew 5:28). The Proverbs warn that engaging with another man's wife results in guilt and destruction of one's own soul (Proverbs 6:29, 32). Jesus further underscores the sanctity of marriage by stating that divorcing a spouse to marry another constitutes adultery (Matthew 19:9; Mark 10:11). Hebrews affirms that marriage should be honored and kept undefiled, with God promising judgment upon adulterers and those who engage in sexual immorality (Hebrews 13:4).
